author: Yffe
content: Generalise the #29 expr-only recursion bound into a single shared guard so every recursive-descent family is capped, not just parse_expr. Add a guard_recursion(inner) helper backed by a unified recursion_depth counter + MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH (kept at 64). Route the four uncapped re-entries through it: parse_expr (parse_or), parse_type (Option<...> self-recursion), parse_pattern (covers both [[...]] slice and Some(Some(..)) enum cycles), and parse_if_parts (the parse_block<->parse_if_parts tail-if cycle from #30). On limit, return the existing structured SyntaxError::ExpressionTooDeep, never abort. Single file: thermite-syntax/src/parser.rs. Verify all four reaudit tests + the existing deep-paren test return on a 2 MiB stack, and depth-40 reasonable nesting still parses; then un-ignore the four reaudit tests.
